newsitem.title: USA: CME LUMBER FUTURES CLOSE LITTLE UP ON CASH TALK.
newsitem.headline: CME LUMBER FUTURES CLOSE LITTLE UP ON CASH TALK.

text.p: Reports that cash lumber was holding firm despite slow trade kept most CME lumber futures supported into the close, traders said.
Lumber closed $3.40 per tbf higher to $4.00 lower with September up most at $359.90 and November up $1.10 at $350.10 per tbf. Only thinly traded deferreds were lower.
Cash lumber prices are holding firm despite continued slow trade. Mills have been able to extend order files out to near September, they said.
But trade was generally slow in futures as prices were holding between technical levels, they added.
